preconditions.description: Number of vertices is between 2 and 10^6.
Maximum weight of an edge is between 1 and 10^6.
Vertex a is between 1 and n.
Vertex b is between 1 and n.
Vertices a and b are distinct.

postconditions.description: The number of beautiful trees is non-negative.
The number of beautiful trees is less than 10^9 + 7.
The output is the count of beautiful trees modulo 10^9 + 7.
